newsitem.title: UK: UK Major's favourite airline snack-gin and Marmite.
newsitem.headline: UK Major's favourite airline snack-gin and Marmite.

text.p: Not for British Prime Minister John Major champagne and caviar on the flight home after a hard day's campaigning.
When Major boarded his plane after electioneering in Yorkshire, northern England, he was in for a treat.

Told by an aide of his favourite snack, cabin crew had been to the shops for a jar of Marmite -- a yeasty paste that has been a staple for generations of schoolboys -- and an up-market brand of potato crisps.
Major tucked in to his Marmite sandwiches not with a cup of tea but a stiff gin and tonic.
